obs.frame: rows 0-48 first-person view (64 wide), rows 49-62 the Craftax inventory strip (63 wide), row 63 black padding

human.controls: UP/DOWN walk forward and back without turning. LEFT/RIGHT turn in place. A/D strafe. SPACE interacts with the cell ahead. TAB sleeps. 1-4 place stone/table/furnace/sapling. 5-7 craft pickaxes, 8-9-0 craft swords (stand next to a table; iron needs a furnace too). I/J/K/L are Craftax's original absolute moves.

reference.name: craftax_classic (this repo), with six movement actions added
reference.parity: NOT a parity port. Craftax's seventeen actions are unchanged and that is gated - over the whole committed corpus, whose actions are all in 0..16, this game produces the same 6880-byte canonical state as craftax_classic every step - but six actions are ADDED, so the action space and therefore the task are not Craftax's
not_matched: the action space: six actions are added (move forward/back, strafe left/right, turn left/right in place) so that a human can play first-person. Craftax has no action that moves without also turning
an agent trained here is NOT comparable to one trained on craftax_classic. For the exact-dynamics first-person environment, use craftax_fp
everything craftax_classic does not match, inherited unchanged: auto-reset RNG continuation across episodes, and the one NOOP the host reset consumes before the first agent action
